title: Defect #4 Confirmation: Cohort-Stratified Verdict & Residual Diagnosis
baseline: tip of phase/6b (A6.1 full stop); master remains phase-5a-approved
scope: diagnosis only - no fix code, no changes to phase_6b's pipeline/artifacts, no full-table passes over filtered_trades. Read-only queries against the already-materialized event_minute_bars_dev_v2 (dev-tier table) are permitted for diagnostic evidence-gathering (not a full-table pass).

sidecar.note: drawn because their archives are degraded, per 5a report SS4 - never pooled with primary in any population-level statistic (same standing rule as Phase 5a)

criteria.note: identical band and threshold as A6.1 - stratification changes the denominator (primary-only vs sidecar-only vs pooled), not the criteria themselves

band_margin.condition: 0.02 <= rel_diff <= 0.07 (within 5 percentage points outside the 2% band) AND internal agreement: |r2' - r1'| / r1' <= 0.10 (r1' and r2' track each other, not one another's noise) AND no coverage anomaly (see coverage_gap condition below is false)
band_margin.interpretation: ordinary cross-definition noise around the same underlying factor (or around 1 for unaffected events) - ordinary population-level noise, not a distinguishable data defect

coverage_gap.condition: (r2' - r1') / r1' > 0.10 (our tick-derived RTH high undershoots what the split-implied factor from r1' alone would predict) AND spine_high_coalesced > day_high_rth AND at least one supporting gap-evidence signal present (RTH bar count materially below the primary-cohort median, OR longest intra-RTH gap materially above the primary-cohort median, OR ETH-vs-RTH row share materially elevated vs. the primary-cohort median)
coverage_gap.interpretation: our own tape is thin/missing at the peak - a per-event tick-coverage gap, not a basis-mechanism failure

classification_rules.materiality_note: 'materially below/above the primary-cohort median' = more than 25% below (bar count) or above (gap minutes, ETH share) the primary-cohort median value

verdict_boolean.name: mechanism_confirmed_on_primary
verdict_boolean.formula: (primary criterion_1_pct >= 90.0) AND (primary criterion_2_pass) AND (primary criterion_3_pass) AND (unexplained_count == 0)
